import.helpTvIntro: Automatically import trades from TradingView alerts:
import.helpTvStep1: Create an alert in TradingView for your strategy
import.helpTvStep2: In the alert settings, enable 'Webhook URL'
import.helpTvStep3: Copy your webhook URL from the 'Automatic Import via Webhook' section above
import.helpTvStep4: Paste the webhook URL and configure the message format with trade details
import.helpNtStep1: Download the NinjaTrader webhook script (coming soon)
import.helpNtStep2: Import the script into NinjaTrader (Tools > Import > NinjaScript)
import.helpNtStep3: Enable the strategy and configure your webhook URL
import.helpNtStep4: Trades will be automatically sent to your journal after each fill

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your trading preferences and account settings
settings.accountDesc: Manage your email and account settings
settings.securityDesc: Change your password and security settings
settings.setupsDesc: Define your trading strategies and setups
settings.tagsDesc: Create tags to organize your trades
settings.emailHelp: Your login email address. A confirmation link will be sent to verify your new email address.
settings.emailUpdateSuccess: Email update initiated. Please check your new email to confirm.
settings.passwordHelp: Must be at least 10 characters. Use a strong, unique password with uppercase, lowercase, numbers and special characters.

passwordStrength.weak: Weak - Add more characters and variety

settings.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters
settings.twoFactorHelp: Adds an extra layer of security by requiring a 6-digit code from your authenticator app when logging in
settings.scanQRCodeDesc: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.)
settings.currencyHelp: Sets the base currency for all P&L calculations and displays throughout your journal. Changing this will affect how your trading results are shown.
settings.timezoneHelp: Determines how trade timestamps are displayed. Select your local timezone or the timezone of the market you're trading. This doesn't change the actual trade times, only how they're shown.
settings.feesHelp: Default commission/fees automatically applied to new trades. This helps calculate your net P&L more accurately. You can override this value for individual trades if needed.
settings.slippageHelp: Expected price difference between order placement and execution (in percentage). Used for more realistic backtesting and performance analysis. Typical values: 0.1-1% depending on your market and instrument.
settings.setupsHelp: Trading strategies or patterns you use (e.g., 'Breakout', 'Mean Reversion', 'Momentum'). These help you analyze which setups work best for you over time.
settings.tagsHelp: Custom labels to categorize trades (e.g., 'High Conviction', 'News Play', 'Tech Sector'). Use tags to filter and analyze your performance by different criteria.
